prompt:
Style: cozy bright pixel art, inspired by Stardew Valley. Pixel grid 32x32 per tile.
Top-down 3/4 view. Warm earthy palette: grass greens, soil browns, sunny yellow,
orange accents, tomato red highlights, cream and milk-brown for UI.
Clean 1px dark brown outline, flat soft shading with 2-3 tones per color, no anti-aliasing,
no gradients, no blur. Transparent background. No text, no watermark, no border frame.
Single subject centered, consistent lighting from the top-left.

Subject: one square flat UI panel, plain OPAQUE warm cream center, milk brown narrow rim, dark brown one logical pixel outline for a final 96x96 asset. Square corners. Fill almost whole canvas. For reliable background extraction ONLY: render outside the panel as uniform vivid magenta (#FF00FF) that will be removed in processing; all cream panel interior must stay opaque. Flat solid fills only, no gradients, shadows or transparent holes. Rim 2 logical pixels total including 1px outer outline; remaining 92x92 logical pixels uniform cream. No text.
processing: Remove magenta background (r>180,b>180,g<100), crop visible bounds, nearest-neighbor to 94x94, center on transparent 96x96, shared palette without dithering, alpha threshold 128.
